dialogues.speaker: Yilong Wharf Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Yilong Wharf Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Frequent sightings of traces of beasts deep in the mountains and in the wilds have been reported, and miasma is present in many areas. The Communications Office sincerely reminds all visitors from abroad to avoid going too deep into the mountains and forests to avoid accidents.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: If you accidentally inhale the miasma and suffer from a headache or fever, do not panic. Rest well for a few days, and you should recover completely.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: "The miasma is a disease that comes and goes imperceptibly. Eat and drink in moderation, follow a regular routine and rest suitably, and you will recover."

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: A criminal gang has been smuggling cultural relics out of the country recently. Citizens are asked to be vigilant and report suspicious activity.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: If you have any information relevant to our investigation, bring it to Hezhe Post for a generous reward. Those who shelter or condone criminals will be severely punished.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: One of my Sumpter Beasts went missing near the mouth of the Bishui River. It has a gentle temperament and loves to eat Jueyun Chili. If any kind souls are able to provide any information as to its whereabouts, my gratitude and a generous reward are guaranteed!

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: All merchants are to strictly abide by the instructions of all harbor officials when unloading goods. Regulations concerning cargo handling are not to be violated!

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Risky and potentially dangerous behaviors such as throwing goods directly into the waterfall are strictly prohibited. "The cargo's tough, and doesn't have feelings to get hurt" is not considered a valid excuse.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: If such behaviors are discovered, the Communications Office will immediately revoke the trading licenses of the relevant personnel and impose severe penalties.

dialogues.speaker: Jiulue Teahouse Advertisement
dialogues.text: Distinguished guests: When passing by, do not let the opportunity to drink in this stunning scenery while drinking quality tea pass you by! Please have a seat, and let our fine establishment serve you the finest teas of Qiaoying Village, washing away your fatigue and soothing the body and mind!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The tea is actually pretty good, but the storytelling is terrible. What was that story I heard last time...? Fujin's Three Captures of the White Snake?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "That's nothing less than a story about the Great Adeptus Fujin! How can it be revised so haphazardly? Alas, moral and artistic standards are degenerating by the day, and the character of people today is far inferior to that of their ancestors..."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "There seems to have been a misunderstanding, dear customer. "Three Captures of the White Snake" is a famous old tale from Liyue Harbor. We couldn't change it even if we wanted to."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "If the story is not to your taste, we'll be telling "Jade Tales" in two days time. We hope you'll return to patronize our establishment."

dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Worried that your valuable goods will be robbed by bandits on the road? Worried about being waylaid by wild beasts while traveling alone in the mountains and forests?

dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency: Delivering all goods safe and sound, and delivering you peace of mind!

dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Note: Any and all consequences that arise due to a failure to honestly disclose the contents of cargo will be borne in their entirety by the customer.

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang Dim Sum Advertisement
dialogues.text: Lianfang Dim Sum, A Century of Sensational Sensations!

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang Dim Sum Advertisement
dialogues.text: Made by hand from start to finish using only traditional, authentic techniques passed down from antiquity. Bringing you an affordable taste of the best Chenyu Vale cuisine has to offer!

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai Advertisement
dialogues.text: Glazed pendants are in stock, with a small number of bracelets also now available. Supplies are limited, buyers make haste, else this opportunity you will waste!

dialogues.speaker: Beautiful Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Hello, do you still have any of the jade Carp pendants I saw last time?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Sorry, those are sold out right now."

dialogues.speaker: Beautiful Handwriting
dialogues.text: "If I had known sooner, I would've bought it then... I wonder if the Carp Adeptus will be angry at me for this. I hope she'll protect Chaoxi and bring him back home as soon as possible..."

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: We trade in precious gems, rare ores, and all related products from Liyue! We have longstanding partnerships with numerous shipping fleets, guaranteeing sufficient supply and stable sales channels.

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: Limited quantity of fashionable silks now for sale. While supplies last!

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: If you have any needs regarding all kinds of quality Sumeru or Fontaine handicrafts, we cordially invite you to visit us for a consultation that is sure to be to your satisfaction.

dialogues.speaker: Advertisement
dialogues.text: Please contact us for all your legal consultation or support needs.

dialogues.speaker: Advertisement
dialogues.text: Whether civil mediation or criminal litigation, our highly professional team of legal consultants will provide you with a customized solution.

dialogues.speaker: Advertisement
dialogues.text: Note: As some legal consultants are exceptionally busy, please inform us in advance if you require the service of a specific legal consultant. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Friends, are you eager to explore the rich history of Liyue's martial arts? Do you want to experience the soul-stirring feeling of being a heroic swordsman?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You're in luck, because now's your chance! Wangshan Hall, the stronghold of the Guhua Clan for a thousand years, is now open to the public, and we sincerely invite chivalrous heroes from all walks of life to come and visit!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Don't miss out, you might never get another chance! Interested parties should visit the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency to make arrangements!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Listen! When I was out on a field investigation a few days ago, I saw a huge beast, it was beautiful, absolutely stunning!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Although there were several mountains between us, the moment I went to grab my Kamera, it jumped up and just disappeared... Could it have been one of those Adepti that I've heard about in the legends of Liyue!?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Adepti have always gathered at Chenyu Vale since ancient times, and meeting an Adeptus isn't a miracle that only happens once every thousand years."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "If this is true, your destiny seems to be entangled with the adepti. Why don't you ascend to Yilong Dais and offer a stick of our famous Crane Crown Incense to them to pray for your good fortune to last?"

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Merchants are not to post any public advertisements without first obtaining prior approval for the contents of the material to be published. Thank you for your cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Poem
dialogues.text: "Beside a bamboo bridge with flowers floating on flowing clear waters, a jade mist lingers on Mt. Xuanlian. The Adepti have been riding the clouds for thousands of years, while the jade pendant rests against the islet."

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Poem
dialogues.text: "The fog is thick, the stone path is far from Lingmeng, the spring is cold, and the pine forest is embroidered with snow. Who would have thought that the moss looks just the same as in the past."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Today's plays: "Xiu Ying Visits the Garden," "White Snake Saves the Orphan," and "Casting of the Jade."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: We hereby announce that next month, Liyue's legendary opera singer and the director of Yun-Han Opera Troupe, Yun Jin, also known as "Sir Yun," will be performing "The Mountain Lord Explores the Valley" on our stage!

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Tickets are limited and sold on a first-come-first-served basis! Any fans of opera shouldn't miss this amazing opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Addendum: Already sold out. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Addendum to the addendum: Standing room tickets are also sold out. Please keep an eye out for our next performance.
